identity_statement: Omega42 is an open mathematical and computational architecture: a common foundation for representing, navigating, analyzing, verifying and connecting structured information, and a protocol by which different AI systems and people address a question to one structure and report what they find in one checkable, sealed format.
state_family: S_k = (Z/3^k)^2, k >= 1, with the tower S_1 <- S_2 <- ... and its limit Z_3^2

required: the shear B and the group <A, B>
the form Q(a, b) = 2a^2 + 2ab - 2b^2 with Q(As) = -Q(s)
the output forms of Core L-549
optional_extensions: the Hermitian 3+1 representation (CONDITIONAL readings under AP-SPACE)
the bridges of Core Appendix S

fields.q: optional absolute quotient, so that no two cells alias (M371)

interfaces.conformance: python3 tools/handshake.py fingerprint | challenge [SEED] (three rounds, levels 6 to 12) | manifest
interfaces.navigation_output: the output forms of Core L-549, checked by python3 tools/output_form.py
interfaces.provenance: python3 tools/authorseal.py init | seal | verify | report | anchor

evidence_states.PROVED: a written proof in the record
evidence_states.VERIFIED: recomputed by a tool in CI
evidence_states.SPECULATIVE: a research direction; never entered in records/math/results.json

release.chain: records/instances/ (each OUTPUT ID chained to the one before)

conformance: self-tested in CI; independent implementations: none yet; independent certification: none yet
is_not: a replacement for TCP/IP or the Internet
a proven universal theory of mathematics
a demonstrated theory of fundamental physics
a demonstrated mechanism for retrocausality or survival after death
a cryptographic primitive (its groups are small and fully known)
proof that all domains share one structure
